(b) 'This MATCHES the standalone ... formula's empirical fit (0.13-0.16% mean across the same spectrum)': 0.184% lies OUTSIDE [0.13, 0.16], so the per-derivation assembly is 15% to 42% WORSE than the fit it is compared with; PROPOSED wording, 'is within a factor 1.2 to 1.4 of'. (c) The headline 'Mean = 0.184%' is right — I recomputed all twelve error rows and the mean from the table and every figure matches — but it averages in the p and n rows, which are 0.000 BY CONSTRUCTION as the free-particle baseline; over the 10 genuinely predicted rows the mean is 0.2209%. (d) alpha = m_e x 8G = 3.74446989 MeV is high by 2.73 ppm against its own definition: recomputed at 25 dps with CODATA m_e = 0.51099895069 and 8G = 7.327724753417752, m_e x 8G = 3.744459660. Catalan itself is handled CORRECTLY here (G approx 0.9160), unlike the s4-s3 proof block in this batch. (e) 'The total B(Z,N) ... is positive for bound systems. QED' asserts positivity without deriving it, under a QED box.
